none: PAS NLM-04F24B: Roman Coin: Denarius of Domitian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver coin. Denarius, possibly of Domitian as Caesar (69-96), mint of Rome issue, Reece period 4; this reporter is not happy with either obverse or reverse readings. Obverse description: Bullnecked bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: possibly CAESAR AVG[?G AV?][F DOMITIANVS]. Reverse description: possibly Jupiter, enthroned right holding vertical sceptre and ?branch extended. Reverse…
